question: For alien data, how many of the top 10 states by alien population have a higher percentage of friendly aliens than hostile aliens, with an average alien age exceeding 200?
sql:
WITH state_stats AS (
    SELECT state, COUNT(*) as alien_count, AVG(age) as avg_age, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as friendly_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hostile_count
    FROM alien_data
    WHERE state IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY state
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT state, alien_count, avg_age, friendly_count, hostile_count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY alien_count DESC) as rn
    FROM state_stats
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as result_count
FROM top10
WHERE rn <= 10
  AND friendly_count > hostile_count
  AND avg_age > 200
